title: Dashboard Design & BI Tools
description: Design interactive, self-service analytics interfaces. Tests information hierarchy, filter design, and real-time monitoring.

seo.overviewTitle: Business Intelligence & Interactive Dashboard Design (Power BI / Tableau)
seo.overviewBody: Business Intelligence (BI) tools translate complex raw data into intuitive visual dashboards for decision-makers. Recruiters evaluate candidates on dimensional data modeling (Star Schema vs Snowflake Schema), writing DAX/LOD measures, and building clean visual hierarchies.

deliverables.title: 1. Interactive BI Dashboard File
deliverables.desc: Power BI (.pbix) or Tableau (.twbx) workbook featuring interactive slicers, KPI scorecards, and trend visualisations.

deliverables.title: 2. Dimensional Data Model Blueprint
deliverables.desc: Data model diagram documenting Star Schema relationships, fact tables, and dimension tables.

deliverables.title: 3. DAX / LOD Measure Specification
deliverables.desc: Documented library of calculated DAX measures (CALCULATE, SUMX) or Tableau Level of Detail expressions.

faqs.question: Why is a Star Schema preferred over flat tables in Power BI?
faqs.answer: Star Schemas eliminate data redundancy, simplify relationship cardinalities, and drastically improve DAX query evaluation speeds.

faqs.question: What is the function of the CALCULATE() measure in Power BI DAX?
faqs.answer: CALCULATE() evaluates an expression under modified filter contexts, allowing analysts to override or expand visual filters dynamically.

faqs.question: How many visuals should be included on a single dashboard page?
faqs.answer: Limit dashboard pages to 4 to 6 core visuals to prevent visual clutter and maintain high rendering performance.
